coverage.decision: Karpathy original is a local app making external OpenRouter calls. Persona skill needs host usage but no separate model API of its own.
Prefer evaluating existing Superpowers model-selection guidance for software execution. Effort and available model mapping remain host integration work.
Optional infrastructure only when native host model controls are insufficient.

decision.council_timing: After requirements are clear, when an important decision warrants review; repeat only for a consequential new decision. No requirement to install Karpathy app before basic interviews or discovery.

decision.cost_note: Chat subscriptions do not automatically supply API credits; original Karpathy application uses OpenRouter API access.

evidence.finding: 2 stargazers observed; created 2026-09-17. Popularity alone does not establish quality, but mature deployment claims would be unsupported.
Explicit worker model selection for mechanical/integration/architecture/review roles and stuck-worker escalation. No universal effort controller or provider access implied.
